checks.name: Actual SQLite header identifies the database container
Schema version and required columns match the declared family
Source database passes SQLite integrity check
tb_books is a real readable table
tb_themes is a real readable table
tb_styles is a real readable table
tb_notes is a real readable table
tb_reading_time is a real readable table
tb_groups is a real readable table
Read-only connection rejects source writes
wrong-version.db does not match the supported family
foreign.db does not match the supported family
Downloaded database7 snapshot has identical synthetic bytes
Source integer IDs remain exact above JavaScript Number precision
Same titles do not collapse distinct source records
Deleted source book is excluded from the default selection
Cloud-only book retains metadata without a fake local file
Unknown note owner is not guessed from other books
Half-star rating converts to the native score
Five-star upper bound converts to 100
Zero is unscored rather than a native zero score
Nullable stored rating follows the source unscored default
Negative rating is rejected
Over-range rating is rejected without clamping
Non-finite rating is rejected
Source finished filter is only a percentage projection
Even a full percentage supplies no completion date or count
Source Book has no independent favorite or current arrangement
Below-threshold percentage supplies no minimum completion
The source 98 percent threshold initializes one unknown-date Work record
A full percentage still supplies only one minimum completion
Existing one-record history is preserved
Existing repeated-completion history is preserved
Part scope adopts a flag without Work completion history
Unknown book grain does not become a Work completion
Invalid or missing percentages do not create completion records
Per-book total sums all distinct daily rows
Same-day legacy rows are not silently discarded
Unknown date does not invalidate an otherwise valid cumulative value
Explicit zero and absent reading data remain different
Multiple selected books can be grouped before one Work adoption
Additional duration replaces the source total minus actual activity
Negative time is rejected
Fractional time is rejected
Time conversion overflow is rejected
Stored reading-time rows contain no complete activity interval
Root group does not create a user collection
Nested group preserves its full readable path
Same leaf name under another parent remains a separate group
Cyclic group path is rejected
Dangling parent does not become a guessed root
Deleted group is excluded
Parent collection includes direct books only
Child collection preserves its own direct book
Reserved style sentinels recover actual tag names
Ordinary font style does not become a tag
Repeated tag relation remains one native membership
Dangling tag reference is isolated
Fractional REAL reference is not truncated to another book
Bookmark color is a progress string instead of an annotation color
Highlight quote and literal reader comment remain separate
Unknown note type still has preservable text
Official GBK text is not silently decoded as UTF-8
Official CSV exposes exactly nine declared columns
GBK CSV preserves Chinese, commas and quotes
CSV newlines and formula punctuation remain literal text
Identical CSV rows stay distinct without source IDs
CSV has no source ID, file hash or CFI to reconstruct positions
CSV bookmark percentage is not interpreted as a hex color
Markdown export is UTF-8 text with its own structure
Plain export retains its body without inferred book metadata
Exact source file path resolves under the selected root
Parent escape is rejected
Foreign absolute drive path is not silently followed
Unconverted EPUB digest matches the corresponding bytes
Original TXT digest is not falsely treated as converted EPUB digest
Converted example retains the original import digest
Adoptable cover contains real decodable image bytes
PDF fixture contains three actual source pages
Bare source CFI maps to the physical PDF page
PDF generated text-layer CFI is not a page-only address
Invalid odd synthetic page step is rejected
Out-of-range source page is not clamped
Comic page order follows source UTF-16 lexical ordering
Source comic extension filter excludes uppercase PNG
Comic synthetic CFI identifies the exact member
Comic member bytes remain actual image data
Copied PDF bytes are identical to the inspected earlier synthetic fixture
Every synthetic input matches its original manifest digest

limits: No actual Anx app export, Flutter runtime, WebDAV sync or native Kisaki write.
Date totals are tested only as cumulative values, not activity intervals.
CFI module checks are separate from these database and fixed-page models.
Path checks are bounded examples, not a complete hostile-filesystem implementation.
